verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://developers.fathom.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the developer docs. Every doc page is also served as a plain .md URL (quickstart.md, webhooks.md, the API reference pages), so an agent can be pointed at the docs and follow them directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other consolidated agent bundle, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and no independent or hands-on report of agents actually consuming these docs.
